purpose: Anti-hallucination re-verification of Necromancy AbilitySpec bands, factories, and data/combat/abilities.json necromancy records against current RuneScape Wiki ability pages.
method: Individual wiki page fetch (infobox + body Damage/Usage sections + update history since 2024-03-04). Engine source: src/combat/styles/necromancy/abilities.ts (+ necrosis.ts, souls.ts). Data: data/combat/abilities.json necromancy:* records. Specs map: src/combat/data/specs.ts ENGINE_ID_BY_RECORD_ID.
verdict: All calculable Necromancy damage bands, adrenaline costs, and factory scalings match live wiki. No engine or JSON band fixes required. Pure utility (Life Transfer, Threads of Fate) correctly excluded from damage lists. Command Vengeful Ghost correctly effect-only (Haunted, no AD% band).

abilities.name: Necromancy (basic attack)
abilities.notes: Counts as basic for Impatient / Fury of the Small since 2 Mar 2026 modernisation. Living Death: +2 Necrosis (effect note).

abilities.name: Soul Sap
abilities.notes: 1 Residual Soul per target with a health bar.

abilities.name: Finger of Death
abilities.adrenaline: -60 base; −10% per Necrosis stack up to 6 (free at 6)
abilities.notes: Living Death multiplies band 1.5× → 405–495%. Always consumes up to 6 Necrosis stacks.

abilities.name: Death Skulls
abilities.notes: Living Death CD → 17 ticks (10.2s) + CD reset. Igneous +2 bounces multi-target only. Bounce/crit-link secondary is multi-target sim territory.

abilities.name: Spectral Scythe (cast 2)
abilities.notes: Engine-only cast; not a separate JSON record (record maps to cast 1).

abilities.name: Spectral Scythe (cast 3)
abilities.notes: Wiki example: 50% remaining → 337.5–412.5%. Factory multiplies base band.

abilities.name: Bloat
abilities.engine_band: 135-165 initial + 10× DoT at 0.25× initial band every 3 ticks
abilities.notes: DoT crit-ineligible; inherits initial crit damage boost. Engine models DoT as 0.25× band for EV (wiki is 25% of rolled initial).

abilities.name: Living Death
abilities.notes: Basic +2 Necrosis; ToD +6% adren; FoD 1.5×; Death Skulls CD 10.2s; resets ToD + Death Skulls CD.

abilities.name: Volley of Souls
abilities.wiki_band: 135-165 per Residual Soul; min 2, max 5 with lantern
abilities.notes: Not in NECROMANCY_ABILITIES array (soul-count factory only). JSON stores per-soul band. Totals: 2→270-330 … 5→675-825.

abilities.name: Blood Siphon
abilities.notes: Solo model is finisher only (channel hits non-primaries). Heal conversion multi-target unmodelled. tickOffset 9.

abilities.name: Command Skeleton Warrior
abilities.wiki_band: 22-28 spirit per hit; 10 hits over 6s (body + Skeleton Warrior page)
abilities.notes: Infobox tooltip summary says '2 hits' and 350% average — 350% is fully-enraged marginal benefit (8 enraged attacks). Body + hit table pin 10 hits. Rage (+3%/stack up to 25) left as effect note. Engine avg 250% = 10×25 base without rage.

abilities.name: Command Putrid Zombie
abilities.notes: Explosion 2.4s after cast (tick+4). Spirit cannot crit.

abilities.name: Command Phantom Guardian
abilities.notes: Valour multiplier is ×(1 + 0.2×stacks) on the hit, not flat AD%. Hit lands 2.4s (tickOffset 4).

abilities.name: Death Grasp
abilities.notes: Death guard special (not bar ability). Consumes all Necrosis. Stun/bind 4.8s wiki (unmodelled CC).

effects_only.name: Command Vengeful Ghost
effects_only.notes: No direct damage band. Applies Haunted (+10% damage, cap 20% Necromancy AD). Correctly in NECROMANCY_EFFECTS only.

effects_only.name: Conjure auto-attacks
effects_only.notes: Auto ticks stay state (conjures.ts) — not AbilitySpecs. Bands wiki-verified; not invented.

json_vs_engine.notes: All 16 necromancy:* records in abilities.json match engine bands/adrenaline/cooldowns for the mapped AbilitySpec. averageDamagePercent fields are single-target EV (Death Skulls 750, Bloat 525, Command Skeleton 250 base without rage). Specs map complete for every filled necro record.

open_notes: Command Skeleton Warrior infobox average 350% includes full rage ramp; engine models base 10×22-28 without rage (documented in NECROMANCY_EFFECTS).
Command Skeleton first-hit tickOffset is 0 in engine; wiki hit table starts attacks 2 ticks after cast (after RAAAR) — timing nuance only, not a band error.
Blood Siphon / Death Skulls multi-target paths intentionally unmodelled.
Spectral Scythe cast 2/3 are engine-only ids (no separate JSON records).
